errors.evidence: The chart title is “实体数目” (Number of entities), but the horizontal axis itself has no label. The description incorrectly identifies the chart title as the axis label.
The categories in the horizontal bar chart are listed vertically from top to bottom. Describing the order as "从左到右" (from left to right) is incorrect and confusing.

errors.text_span: 图表有效地传达了不同类别的实体数量分布情况
errors.evidence: The phrase "有效地传达了" (effectively communicates) is a subjective evaluation of the chart's quality, which goes beyond objective description.
